metadata.question: Was the total rainfall in Grafton, New South Wales, greater than the total rainfall in Canberra from January 15, 2020 to January 21, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need precipitation data for two locations (Grafton, NSW and Canberra) during Jan 15-21, 2020. Good options are: - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - daily precipitation - GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) - but CHIRPS is more reliable for rainfall 2. Masking strategy: For rainfall data, we don't need cloud masking since we're looking at precipitation data directly. 3. Logic: Sum rainfall over the period for both locations, compare the totals. 4. Data quality checks: - Check if collections have data for both locations - Check if we get valid precipitation values - Make sure we're not getting null/NaN results Let me define the locations: - Grafton, NSW: approx (-29.681, 152.933) - Canberra: approx (-35.2809, 149.1300) I'll use CHIRPS daily precipitation data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const grafton = ee.Geometry.Point([152.933, -29.681]); const canberra = ee.Geometry.Point([149.1300, -35.2809]); const startDate = '2020-01-15'; const endDate = '2020-01-21'; // 2. Data Acquisition const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); // Check collection size const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS images in period: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate total rainfall for each location const totalRainfall = chirps.sum(); // Get rainfall values const graftonRain = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: grafton, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const canberraRain = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: canberra, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Grafton total rainfall: ${graftonRain?.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Canberra total rainfall: ${canberraRain?.toFixed(2)} mm`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (graftonRain === null || canberraRain === null || isNaN(graftonRain) || isNaN(canberraRain)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (graftonRain > canberraRain) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
